**Available Operation**

| No. | Operation | Function Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **1** | **createProjectBoard()** | Instantiates and initializes the project workspace. |
| **2** | **addProjectMember()** | Adds team members to a specific project. |
| **3** | **assignProjectRole()** | Maps added team members to designated roles based on template specs. |
| **4** | **retrieveProjectData()** | Retrieves project metadata. |
| **5** | **retrieveTemplateDefinition()** | Sets up workspace rules and settings based on the selected template. |
| **6** | **getAvailableTemplates()** | Retrieve list of template available within the system |
| **7** | **createWorkItem()** | Creates work items according to user specification and template definition. |
| **8** | **retrieveWorkItem()** | Retrieves work items according to the project. |
| **9** | **editWorkItem()** | Edits work item attributes (assignee, reporter, custom fields). |
| **10** | **removeWorkItem()** | Removes work items from both backlog and its related sprint. |
| **11** | **validateWorkItemAttributes()** | Validates if the work item is following defined validation rules. |
| **12** | **createSprint()** | Creates a sprint with beginning date and end date. |
| **13** | **editSprint()** | Changes sprint data such as starting/ending time and work items. |
| **14** | **retrieveSprintData()** | Retrieves metadata of the sprint together with related tasks. |
| **15** | **assignWorkItemToSprint()** | Assigns created work items to sprint. |
| **16** | **calculateSprintWorkSummary()** | Aggregates and categorizes work items into planned, completed, carry-over, blocked. |
| **17** | **retrieveSprintMetrics()** | Fetches performance data, work items, and progress stats for selected Sprint. |
| **18** | **generateSprintReviewSummary()** | Consolidates quantitative metrics and qualitative feedback into standardized reports. |
| **19** | **createSprintReflection()** | Captures user qualitative reflection based on template attributes and binds to sprint. |
| **20** | **retrieveSprintReflection()** | Retrieves the submitted reflection and feedback associated with a specific Sprint. |
| **21** | **exportSummaryReport()** | Formats and outputs generated review summary for presentation or download. |

|  | **editSprint()** | \- |
